lines.differs: Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: shorter payment term of 30 days from receipt instead of 45 days.
Same as PayTrack Technologies: payment term is 30 days from receipt of invoice.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: payment is due 30 days from receipt of invoice instead of 30 days from the invoice date.
Better for AtliQ than Crestline Retail Inc: confidentiality obligations expire after 3 years without an indefinite survival period for trade secrets.
Same as Al Noor Hospitality Group: standard mutual confidentiality obligations and a need-to-know disclosure restriction.
Same as Al Noor Hospitality Group: standard mutual confidentiality obligations and use for the specific purpose only.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: the client owns the specific dashboards and configurations upon payment instead of AtliQ retaining ownership.
Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: license for pre-existing IP is restricted to internal business purposes and is non-transferable.
Same as Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: deliverables developed specifically for the client are owned by the client upon full payment.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: liability for confidentiality violations is excluded from the aggregate cap.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: liability cap is based on total fees under the agreement instead of individual SOW values.
Worse for AtliQ than Rohan Iyer: aggregate liability is capped at the total contract fees rather than the preceding twelve months' fees.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: indemnity covers any non-compliance and simple negligence instead of specific violations and gross negligence.
Worse for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: indemnity covers any non-compliance and simple negligence rather than specific events and gross negligence.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: indemnity covers any non-compliance and simple negligence instead of specific items and gross negligence.
Better for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: liquidated damages are explicitly stated as the sole and exclusive remedy for delays.
Better for AtliQ than Brightwater Insurance Inc: liquidated damages are 0.5% of the milestone fee per week, capped at 5%, and are the exclusive remedy.
Better for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: lower rate of 0.5% per week and an express 5% cap on milestone fee liability.
Worse for AtliQ than Acme Retail Group: includes additional requirements to comply with international laws and formal data return or deletion procedures.
Better for AtliQ than PayTrack Technologies: notification of security incidents is required without undue delay rather than within twenty-four hours and removes audit rights.
Worse for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: requires compliance with data protection laws for properties located outside of India.
Same as PayTrack Technologies: disputes are resolved by a sole arbitrator under Indian law, though the venue is Mumbai instead of Pune.
Better for AtliQ than CloudSpan Technologies: governing law is Indian law and arbitration is local, rather than Singapore law and SIAC arbitration.
Same as Orbit Travels Pvt Ltd: disputes are settled by a sole arbitrator under Indian law, despite the change in venue to Mumbai.
